title: No leader: any node coordinates, the partition key picks 3 replicas
caption: hash(partition key) gives a token on the ring; the next RF = 3 nodes clockwise own that partition.

steps.text: The client driver sends the request to any node; that node acts as coordinator for this request only. There is no primary to fail over.
The coordinator hashes the partition key (conversation_id = c1) to a token and finds the 3 nodes that own it on the ring.
It forwards to all 3 replicas in parallel and waits for as many as the consistency level asks for (1, 2 = QUORUM, or 3 = ALL).
Every row of partition c1 lives on exactly these 3 nodes. Adding nodes moves token ranges, not individual rows.
